title: Event sitemap entries declared lastmod as the start date, which is in the future for every upcoming event

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-sitemap finder). lib/events/series-seo.ts documented startsAt as the sitemap's lastModified, and app/sitemap.ts wrote it, so every upcoming event carried a future lastmod. Google documents a consistently inaccurate lastmod as grounds to ignore the field for the whole file, which would also cost the Space, help and journey entries their real dates. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the reader selects events.updated_at, SitemapEventEntry carries it as updatedAt, and the sitemap uses it with the LIVE-197 rule (absent beats invented); lib/events/series-seo.test.ts pins the field name and the absence of the start date.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const sm=fs.readFileSync("app/sitemap.ts","utf8");const r=fs.readFileSync("lib/events/series-seo.ts","utf8");if(/lastModified: new Date\(e\.startsAt\)/.test(sm)||!/e\.updatedAt/.test(sm)||!/updated_at/.test(r)){console.error("SCAN-661: event sitemap entries declare lastmod as the START date, which is in the future for every upcoming event; Google names a future or inaccurate lastmod as grounds to ignore the field for the whole sitemap.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
